name: teynard-1851-sphinx-chest
note: Felix Teynard, 'Djizeh (Necropole de Memphis), Sphinx et Pyramides', calotype 1851-52, printed 1853-54 (Blanquart-Evrard / Goupil, Paris). Metropolitan Museum of Art 1976.607.8, https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/261882 , Open Access (isPublicDomain true; CC0). 3764x3025 JPEG, the Met 'original' size. Sphinx buried to the chest, sand to the lower chest, no people, Khafre's pyramid behind. Rotation not needed

name: ducamp-1849-le-sphinx
note: Maxime Du Camp, 'Egypte Moyenne, Le Sphinx', negative December 1849, printed 1852 (Blanquart-Evrard, Lille; plate 11). Metropolitan Museum of Art 2015.778.35, https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/700111 , Open Access (CC0). 3808x2658 JPEG; the photo is only about 40% of the sheet (the rest is the mount). Sphinx head and chest standing in a hollow of sand

name: greene-1853-excavations-near-sphinx
note: John Beasley Greene, '[Excavations near the Sphinx]', 1853, salted paper print. Metropolitan Museum of Art 2005.100.276, https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/286665 , Open Access (CC0). 3984x3089 JPEG. Optional: the Sphinx head is a small shape on the skyline with a flag; the men in front are at a dig in the foreground, NOT next to the Sphinx, so they give no scale for it

name: matson-17964-sphinx-profile
note: G. Eric and Edith Matson Photograph Collection, Library of Congress, matpc.17964 (catalog record mpc2010003453), 'Egypt. Sphinx & pyramids. Sphinx (profile, rather close view)', 'between 1934 and 1939'. Library of Congress: 'No known restrictions on publication'. The url is the 16 MB greyscale master TIFF (4617x3459); the saved file is that TIFF converted to RGB JPEG quality 92 with Pillow. Fully excavated body in side view; paws are NOT in the frame. The service jpg is https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/service/pnp/matpc/17900/17964v.jpg . loc.gov pages answer a Cloudflare challenge to curl, tile.loc.gov does not. Commons mirror (File:Egypt. Sphinx & pyramids. Sphinx (profile, rather close view) LOC matpc.17964.jpg) is rate limited (429)

name: matson-17957-sphinx-paws
note: Matson Photograph Collection, Library of Congress, matpc.17957 (record mpc2010003446), 'Egypt. Sphinx & pyramids. Gen[eral] view with pyramid in background', 'between 1934 and 1939'. 'No known restrictions on publication'. Master TIFF 4624x3479 converted to JPEG q92. Three-quarter side view of the whole cleared body with both paws (brick-like Roman casing) in the foreground right, Khufu's pyramid behind. Service jpg: https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/service/pnp/matpc/17900/17957v.jpg
